issue.title: Auto-cleanup SDLC state when issues are closed

acceptance_criteria.description: [TASK-1-1] Workflow file exists with correct trigger (issues types [closed]) and required permissions (actions write, contents write, issues write)
[TASK-1-2] Job only runs when issue has egg-sdlc label
[TASK-1-3] In-progress sdlc-pipeline runs for the issue are cancelled (HITL runs are not cancelled due to GitHub API limitations; see workflow header comment for rationale)
[TASK-1-4] Branch egg/issue-{N} is deleted if it exists
[TASK-1-5] Workflow succeeds gracefully if branch already deleted or workflow already cancelled
[TASK-2-1] Branch is NOT deleted if an open PR exists on the branch
[TASK-2-2] Issue receives a comment documenting what was cleaned up
[TASK-2-3] Workflow continues and reports status even if one cleanup operation fails
[TASK-3-1] Branch deleted, workflows cancelled, comment posted
[TASK-3-2] Branch deleted (PR already merged), no duplicate cleanup

tasks.description: Create on-issue-closed.yml workflow file with correct trigger and permissions
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Workflow file exists with correct trigger (issues types [closed]) and required permissions (actions write, contents write, issues write)
tasks.notes: Workflow has issues trigger with closed type, and actions/contents/issues write permissions

tasks.description: Add job condition to filter for SDLC issues only
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Job only runs when issue has egg-sdlc label
In-progress sdlc-pipeline runs for the issue are cancelled (HITL runs are not cancelled due to GitHub API limitations)
tasks.notes: Cancels sdlc-pipeline runs by checking branch name and inputs. HITL runs are not cancelled because GitHub API doesn't expose concurrency group info needed to identify which runs belong to which issue.

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Branch egg/issue-{N} is deleted if it exists
tasks.notes: Uses gh api to check and delete branch via git refs API

tasks.description: Add idempotency handling for cleanup operations
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Workflow succeeds gracefully if branch already deleted or workflow already cancelled
tasks.notes: All operations use 2>/dev/null with fallbacks for missing resources

tasks.description: Add check for open PRs before branch deletion
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Branch is NOT deleted if an open PR exists on the branch
tasks.notes: Checks for open PRs before deletion and skips if any exist

tasks.description: Add audit comment to issue on cleanup completion
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Issue receives a comment documenting what was cleaned up
tasks.notes: Posts cleanup summary with detailed status of all operations

tasks.description: Add error handling for partial failures
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Workflow continues and reports status even if one cleanup operation fails
tasks.notes: Uses continue-on-error pattern with error tracking in ERRORS variable

tasks.description: Test cleanup on manually closed issue
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Branch deleted, workflows cancelled, comment posted
tasks.notes: Manual testing - workflow deployed, needs real-world test

tasks.description: Test cleanup when PR merge closes issue
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Branch deleted (PR already merged), no duplicate cleanup
tasks.notes: Manual testing - workflow deployed, needs real-world test

tasks.description: Test cleanup when branch does not exist
tasks.notes: Manual testing - workflow deployed, needs real-world test

tasks.description: Test cleanup when workflows are not running
tasks.notes: Manual testing - workflow deployed, needs real-world test
